text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- "Those who decide to secede from Bosnia must annex themselves to someone but knowing the interests of Belgrade, Serbs from Republika Srpska have nowhere to go," Michael Steiner, deputy to the High Representative for Bosnia, Carl Bildt, says in an interview.
- John Menzies, the United States ambassador to Bosnia resigns from his post for family reasons and is going back to the United States, the newspaper quoted an unnamed embassy official as saying.

- The European Union plans to donate $38 million to Bosnia this year with 85 percent for the Moslem-Croat federation and 15 percent for the Serb republic, EU ambassador Donato Chierini says in an interview.
